grain: one row = one order at the moment of purchase (before fulfillment)
target_definition: 1 if the order was returned or disputed within 30 days of delivery, else 0

fields.name: order_id
fields.note: Unique key, not a model feature

fields.name: order_value
fields.why: High-value orders have more return incentive

fields.name: category
fields.why: Return rates vary sharply by category

fields.name: customer_order_count
fields.why: Proxy for trust/loyalty; 0 for new customers

fields.name: payment_method
fields.why: COD correlates with higher RTO/return risk

fields.name: discount_percent
fields.why: Heavy discounts sometimes correlate with impulse returns

notes: These exact field names are the CSV columns, the FastAPI JSON keys, and the Lovable UI labels. No renaming mid-project.
Base rate is sampled realistically (~5-15%), not 50/50. Use PR-AUC and class weighting, not plain accuracy.
order_id is dropped before training; it is never a model feature.
